title: Civil QA/QC Engineer
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Civil QA/QC Engineer responsible for ensuring civil construction activities comply with approved drawings, project specifications, ITPs, Method Statements, ISO requirements, and applicable Oman/GCC standards. Key Responsibilities Monitor and inspect excavation, backfilling, foundations, rebar, formwork, concrete, blockwork, waterproofing, and finishing works. Review drawings, specifications, Method Statements, ITPs, and material submittals. Prepare and manage IR, MIR, WIR, NCRs, checklists, inspection reports, and QA/QC records . Coordinate concrete, soil, material, and laboratory testing activities. Ensure compliance with approved specifications, project quality plans, and applicable standards. Coordinate with consultants, clients, subcontractors, and site teams for inspections and quality issues. Identify non-conformities and follow up corrective and preventive actions. Maintain calibration and quality documentation records. Participate in internal quality audits and support project handover/QA-QC dossiers. Implement and maintain ISO 9001 Quality Management System requirements. 
 Preferred candidate profile Bachelors Degree/Diploma in Civil Engineering . 5–10 years of Civil QA/QC experience, preferably in Oman/GCC projects. ISO 9001 Lead Auditor certification is preferred/required. Strong knowledge of QA/QC procedures, ITPs, Method Statements, NCRs, and inspection documentation. Knowledge of ASTM, ACI, BS and ISO 9001 standards. Experience with consultant/client inspections and quality audits. Good communication, coordination, and reporting skills. Oman/GCC project experience preferred.

Key Skills: ITP,Quality System Management,QC Inspection,Quality Control Management,Quality Management,Method Statement,Material Inspection,Quality Procedures
